**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place).** `implements Core\Db\Queryable` is now `E0328` ("is implemented only by `Core` classes"), not the `E0303` "no such class". `nvs_hir::CoreRoster::Names` carries `links` and `closed`, and `nvs_stdlib::registry::closed_interfaces` builds `closed` from the `CoreInterface` roster.

Gap `a-callable-has-no-bind-bindto-or-call` now waits on the question *What may `bindTo`, `bind` and `call` rebind a closure to?*. A closure's `$this` is a captured field typed against the enclosing class, and a `callable` type does not say whether it uses `$this`, so what a rebind may target is a user decision. Seven questions wait in the goal prose's § *Questions for the user at the goal end*. Do not build the closure rebind, the environment, the zip walk or the captured-output type before the answers. **No session stops on `BLOCKED` before the goal end.**

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red because `main` is ahead of `origin/main`. It leaves with goal `ci-green`'s record in Stage 6, and nobody pushes for it.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names 9 gaps. Six wait on questions. The three without one are the route-name half of `route-name-and-directive-completion-are-unbuilt`, `the-website-grammar-is-hand-written-beside-the-editors` and `rendered-core-pages-lag-the-tree`. Read each gap's record before building it. A change to a file a perf figure is keyed to stales that figure: run `bun nv proofs --owed`, then `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group '<class>'` per class it names.
